key_points: Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold another $300M of shares, adding to ~$1B of sales since late August.
Insider selling may signal near-term profit-taking despite strong fundamentals.
Morningstar highlighted a large dividend hike, indicating confidence in cash flow.
Reports of President Trump buying Nvidia stock provide a modest positive cue.
The Globe and Mail flagged a concerning metric in the recent quarter, hinting at potential headwinds.
